subject: Bump minimum cmake version to 3.24 (#4232)
reason: The change is a one-line build-system edit: it raises cmake_minimum_required from 3.10 to 3.24 in CMakeLists.txt. It alters no source code, no command behaviour, no replication/persistence path, and no replies; any build that compiles is byte-for-byte governed by the same sources as before. This is a build/CI change with no runtime behaviour change, so no scenario is needed.
